svg.aria-label: Barshana Chatterjee, at Barshana24. I build things that put AI to work on real data, usually on a local model. Kolkata, India. Open to collaboration. Brief. I build things that put AI to work on real data, usually on a local model. Most of what I ship runs fully offline: no API keys, and nothing leaves the machine it runs on. Operating principle: if a model can run on the machine that already holds the data, it should. Current focus: LOCAL-LLM TOOLING, docs, code review, prompt compression; AGENT BENCHMARKS, upstream CLI work on AOBench for HPC; RF · DSP, SIW antenna design, Springer Nature paper. Open to collaboration. Signals. PUBLIC REPOS: 14, SHIPPED TOOLS: 6, UPSTREAM PRs: 3, PUBLICATIONS: 1. Systems map, weighted by use. Languages: Python 92, TypeScript 84, SQL 70, JavaScript 48, MATLAB 22. Runtime and data: Ollama / local LLMs 90, FastAPI 78, React / Next.js 72, PostgreSQL 58, BigQuery 44. Pipeline, how a project gets built left to right: INGEST using Python · BigQuery, then STORE using PostgreSQL, then REASON using Ollama, local, then SERVE using FastAPI, then INTERFACE using React / Next.js. Step 03 runs on the local machine, so no keys and no data leave the box.
